lipsync.note: One-time: set this to your local lipsync tool command. It receives {video} {audio} {out} and must write a lipsynced MP4 to {out}. Wav2Lip example: python C:/tools/Wav2Lip/inference.py --checkpoint C:/tools/Wav2Lip/checkpoints/wav2lip_gan.pth --face {video} --audio {audio} --outfile {out} . Leave empty to skip lipsync and just mux your VO over the Veo clip.
